Apple Earnings Summary

Apple posted Q3 2026 earnings on July 30, 2026, reporting an EPS of $2.02, which topped analysts' consensus estimates of $1.89 by $0.13. Quarterly revenue rose 16.4% year-over-year to $109.42 billion, above analyst estimates of $109.04 billion. With a trailing EPS of $8.72 and a P/E Ratio of 38.87, Apple's earnings are expected to grow 9.04% next year, from $8.74 to $9.53 per share.

Apple Earnings - Frequently Asked Questions

Apple has not confirmed its next earnings publication date, but the company's estimated earnings date is Thursday, October 29th, 2026 based off last year's report dates. Learn more on AAPL's earnings history.

Apple updated its fourth quarter 2026 earnings guidance on Thursday, July, 30th. The company issued revenue guidance of $111.7 billion-$113.7 billion, compared to the consensus revenue estimate of $114.3 billion.

In the previous quarter, Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) reported $2.02 earnings per share (EPS) to beat the analysts' consensus estimate of $1.89 by $0.13. Learn more on analysts' earnings estimate vs. AAPL's actual earnings.

Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) has a recorded annual revenue of $466.82 billion.

Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) has a recorded net income of $112.01 billion. AAPL has generated $8.72 earnings per share over the last four quarters.

Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) has a trailing price-to-earnings ratio of 38.87 and a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 38.78. The price/earnings-to-growth ratio is 2.92.

Apple's earnings are expected to grow from $8.74 per share to $9.53 per share in the next year, which is a 9.04% increase.
